tools.description: List locally tracked FYI/Alaveteli official information requests, ordered newest first. Use for dashboards, triage, or finding an ID before retrieve_request; do not use when you already know the ID and need correspondence (use retrieve_request) or only need health metrics (use check_status). Read-only and idempotent; does not contact remote authorities.

inputSchema.description: Optional filters for the request list.

limit.description: Maximum number of request records to return (1-500). Defaults to 100 when omitted; raise only when the agent needs a broader scan.

tools.name: list_requests

requests.description: Requests ordered by most recently updated.

body.description: Request body or draft correspondence text.

tags.description: Optional local tags attached to the request.

title.description: Public title of the official information request.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 update timestamp used for ordering and sync.

url.description: Canonical public request URL when available.

tools.title: List Requests

tools.description: Retrieve one locally tracked FYI/Alaveteli request and its stored correspondence by request ID. Use after list_requests when you need full text/history for a single request; do not use for bulk listing (list_requests) or database health (check_status). Read-only and idempotent; fails if the ID is missing; never contacts remote sites.

id.description: Stable local request ID to load (must already exist; typically from list_requests).

tools.name: retrieve_request

correspondence.description: Stored correspondence items linked to the request, in database order.

items.description: A correspondence item associated with an FYI request.

attachments.description: Optional attachment URLs or identifiers linked to the correspondence.

body.description: Message body or extracted correspondence text.

direction.description: Whether the correspondence was sent by the requester or received as an authority response.

state.description: Optional Alaveteli correspondence state when captured.

body.description: Request body or draft correspondence text.

tags.description: Optional local tags attached to the request.

title.description: Public title of the official information request.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 update timestamp used for ordering and sync.

url.description: Canonical public request URL when available.

tools.title: Retrieve Request

tools.description: Create a new local FYI/Alaveteli request row (draft or tracked) in SQLite. Use only when starting a new request; use update_request to change an existing ID and delete_request to remove one. Mutating and not idempotent: each call allocates a new ID. Does not submit to a remote authority, send email, or require network access; title and body are required.

inputSchema.description: Fields for the request to create.

body.description: Full request body or draft text to store locally (required, non-empty).

status.description: Optional initial local lifecycle status. Prefer draft until the request is ready; does not trigger remote submission.

tags.description: Optional local classification tags for filtering/reporting; replace-not-merge semantics only apply on update_request.

url.description: Optional absolute FYI/Alaveteli URL when the request already exists online; omit for pure local drafts.

user_name.description: Optional requester display name for local tracking only.

tools.name: create_request

request.description: The newly created local request record.

body.description: Request body or draft correspondence text.

tags.description: Optional local tags attached to the request.

title.description: Public title of the official information request.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 update timestamp used for ordering and sync.

url.description: Canonical public request URL when available.

tools.title: Create Request

tools.description: Replace editable fields on an existing local FYI/Alaveteli request by ID and mark the record dirty for offline sync. Use when the request already exists and fields changed; use create_request for a new ID and delete_request to remove. Requires id, title, and body (full replacement for those fields, not a sparse patch). Mutating but non-destructive; safe to re-run with the same values; does not call remote APIs.

body.description: Replacement request body or draft text (required; full replace).

id.description: Existing local request ID to update (must already exist).

status.description: Optional replacement local lifecycle status; omission clears the stored value. Changing status does not submit or withdraw a remote request.

tags.description: Optional full replacement tag list; omission clears the stored value.

title.description: Replacement request title (required; full replace, not merge).

url.description: Optional replacement absolute FYI/Alaveteli URL; omission clears the stored value.

user_name.description: Optional replacement requester display name; omission clears the stored value.

tools.name: update_request

body.description: Request body or draft correspondence text.

tags.description: Optional local tags attached to the request.

title.description: Public title of the official information request.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 update timestamp used for ordering and sync.

url.description: Canonical public request URL when available.

tools.title: Update Request

tools.description: Permanently delete a local request and all of its stored correspondence from SQLite. Use only after the agent confirms the ID should be discarded; prefer update_request for status/text edits and list_requests/retrieve_request for inspection. Destructive and irreversible in this database; does not delete anything on remote FYI/Alaveteli sites.

id.description: Stable local request ID to delete permanently.

tools.name: delete_request

deleted.description: True when the local delete operation completed.

request_id.description: Request ID that was targeted for deletion.

tools.title: Delete Request

tools.description: List imported public authority records (government/public bodies) used to route or classify FOI/OIA requests. Use to browse existing slugs/names before drafting; use import_authorities to add or upsert records, and list_requests for request data. Read-only and idempotent; returns the full local authority table (no pagination).
tools.name: list_authorities

items.description: Public authority record used to route or classify requests.

slug.description: Stable authority slug used as an import key.

tools.title: List Authorities

tools.description: Upsert local public authority reference records by slug for request routing and discovery. Use after list_authorities when seeding or refreshing the catalog; do not use for FOI request CRUD (create_request/update_request). Mutating but non-destructive and idempotent: same slug re-import updates name/url without creating duplicates; does not contact remote authority directories.

authorities.description: Authority records to upsert; slug is the primary key, name is required, url is optional. All names are checked before writes; a later database failure can leave earlier rows imported.

items.description: Public authority record used to route or classify requests.

slug.description: Stable authority slug used as an import key.

tools.name: import_authorities

imported.description: Number of authority records accepted for import or update.

tools.title: Import Authorities

tools.description: Summarize offline synchronization health: clean/dirty/conflict request counts, outgoing queue depth, latest sync time, and offline degradation indicators. Use for an operations overview; prefer sync_status for one request, sync_conflicts to list conflicted rows, and check_status for database connectivity/record totals. Read-only and idempotent; does not start a sync job.
tools.name: sync_monitor

offline_degradation.description: Operational indicators showing queued local changes and dirty records.

queued_changes.description: Pending plus failed outgoing queue entries.

queue.description: Outgoing offline queue counts by pending, submitted, and failed status.

failed.description: Outgoing queue entries that failed submission.

pending.description: Outgoing queue entries waiting to be submitted.

sync.description: Aggregate request sync counts and latest sync timestamp.

clean.description: Requests known to be cleanly synchronized.

total.description: Total number of requests tracked by sync metadata.

tools.title: Sync Monitor

tools.description: List locally tracked requests whose offline sync metadata is marked conflict. Use after sync_monitor shows conflict>0 to obtain IDs for review; use sync_resolve_conflict to clear a conflict, list_requests for all requests regardless of sync state. Read-only and idempotent; does not resolve conflicts or start network sync.

inputSchema.description: Optional filters for the conflict list.

limit.description: Maximum number of conflicted request records to return (1-500). Defaults to 100 when omitted.

tools.name: sync_conflicts

conflicts.description: Requests with sync_status set to conflict.

items.description: A request currently marked as a sync conflict.

body.description: Request body or draft correspondence text.

tags.description: Optional local tags attached to the request.

title.description: Public title of the official information request.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 update timestamp used for ordering and sync.

url.description: Canonical public request URL when available.

tools.title: Sync Conflicts

tools.description: Resolve a local offline-sync conflict by updating only the request's sync metadata: mark_clean=true after the agent has reconciled local vs remote (status becomes clean); mark_clean=false keeps the row dirty for a later push. Prerequisite: the request should already appear in sync_conflicts. Side effects are local SQLite metadata only—no automatic merge of body text, no remote API calls, and no deletion of the request. Prefer sync_conflicts to list candidates and sync_status to inspect timestamps; do not use for ordinary field edits (update_request). Mutating, non-destructive, and idempotent for the same mark_clean value.

mark_clean.description: true: mark reconciled/clean after manual review; false (default): leave dirty so a later offline push is expected. Does not rewrite title/body.

request_id.description: Local request ID currently in conflict (from sync_conflicts).

tools.name: sync_resolve_conflict

request_id.description: Request ID whose conflict state was updated.

resolved.description: True when the conflict metadata was written successfully.

sync_status.description: Resulting sync status string (typically clean or dirty).

tools.title: Resolve Sync Conflict

tools.description: Read offline-sync metadata either as aggregate counts (omit request_id) or for one request (provide request_id). Use when you need clean/dirty/pending/conflict numbers or per-request last_synced timestamps; use sync_monitor for queue depth + offline degradation, sync_conflicts for conflicted rows only, and check_status for database health. Read-only and idempotent; does not mutate state or trigger network sync.

inputSchema.description: Optional request identifier for per-request sync metadata.

request_id.description: Optional local request ID. Omit for aggregate counts; set to load that request's sync_status, last_synced_at, and conflict_version.

tools.name: sync_status

outputSchema.description: Synchronization metadata. Aggregate counts are returned when request_id is omitted; per-request metadata is returned when request_id is provided.

clean.description: Number of requests with clean sync metadata.

conflict.description: Number of requests currently in conflict.

dirty.description: Number of requests with unsynced local changes.

pending.description: Number of requests queued or pending sync.

total.description: Total number of requests represented in aggregate sync status.

conflict_version.description: Conflict version counter when a sync conflict has been detected.

last_synced_at.description: Last successful sync timestamp for this request.

local_updated_at.description: Last local update timestamp known for this request.

remote_updated_at.description: Last remote update timestamp known for this request.

request_id.description: Request ID for the per-request sync lookup.

sync_status.description: Per-request sync status, or null when that request has no sync metadata.

tools.title: Sync Status

tools.description: Check FYI MCP SQLite readiness and return record-count metrics for requests, correspondence, and optional sync totals. Use as a first health probe or liveness check; prefer sync_monitor for queue/offline depth and list_requests for request content. Read-only, idempotent, and safe to call repeatedly; does not write data or contact remote services.
tools.name: check_status

database.description: Database connection state used by the MCP server.

metrics.description: Record-count metrics for core FYI tables.

sync.description: Aggregate sync counts when sync metadata can be read.

conflict.description: Number of requests in sync conflict.

dirty.description: Number of requests with unsynced local changes.

total.description: Total number of requests represented in sync metadata.

total_correspondence.description: Number of correspondence records in the database.

total_requests.description: Number of request records in the database.

status.description: Overall service health, reported as healthy when database queries succeed.

tools.title: Check Status

tools.description: Compute a statutory FOI/OIA deadline from a start date and day count using the bleeding-edge fyi-core deadline engine. Use for local working-day or calendar-day deadline math; do not use for listing requests (list_requests) or sync health (sync_monitor). Read-only and idempotent; pure calculation with no database or network access. Returns a StatutoryDeadline JSON object (start_date, due_date, statutory_deadline_days, working_day_rule).

calendar.description: When true, count calendar days including weekends; when false/omitted, count weekdays only (Mon–Fri).

days.description: Number of statutory days to count after start_date (0-36500, working days by default).

start_date.description: Inclusive statutory period start date in YYYY-MM-DD (typically submission/receipt day).

tools.name: compute_deadline

statutory_deadline_days.description: Day count used in the calculation.

tools.title: Compute Deadline

query.description: Free-text search query tokenized into alphanumeric terms.

outputSchema.description: Ranked search results over the demo corpus.

document_count.description: Number of documents in the demo corpus.
